title: FrontierCS 2 Benchmark Tests if AI Agents Can Outdo Published CS Research
summary:
A new evaluation tool challenges AI models to surpass the technical achievements of published academic studies in computer science. Known as FrontierCS 2, the benchmark removes the specific contribution from a research paper's released code and tasks LLM agents with outperforming the original method based on metrics defined by the authors. To ensure an authentic test of research capabilities, these agents are denied access to the internet and the original papers.

The project is powered by Modal and examines whether autonomous agents can recreate complex components from scratch while introducing improvements. Researcher Ofir Press stated that this testing framework will be a primary training and test objective for the field, with more tasks scheduled for release to further explore the limits of AI in CS research.
